author: CNET
description:
"I’ve taken some of my favorite iPhone images ever with the iPhone 18 Pro Max," writes CNET director of content Patrick Holland. "And yet, I don’t think just anyone should buy it."

Most people might be better served by grabbing an iPhone 17, even at its higher $929 starting price, than one of the new $1,199 Pros, but if you're a self-professed "camera nerd" like Patrick, it may be time focus in on an upgrade.

description:
